name: pugbase
description: Search, read and write your team's PugBase notes and plans from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
PugBase is a shared workspace where product teams keep their specs, decisions, plans and test results as notes. This plugin lets ChatGPT work with that workspace directly.

What you can do:
- Find notes by keyword and read them in full, including tables, checklists and diagrams
- Look at images embedded in a note, such as screenshots and mockups
- Read the comment threads the team left on a note
- Read a team's plan with each task's progress
- Create new notes from markdown, append a section to an existing note, and replace a note's content when it is out of date (the previous version is kept in history)
- Upload an image and embed it in a note

Each connection is bound to one workspace you choose when signing in, and ChatGPT can only reach what you can see in PugBase.
defaultPrompt: Find the release checklist in PugBase.
What comments are on our team handbook in PugBase?
Summarise our PugBase plan and which tasks are still open.

positive.description: Find and read a note by topic
positive.prompt: Find the release checklist in PugBase and tell me what is left to do.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Release Checklist note, reads it, and lists the unchecked items (staging smoke test, tag and deploy, announce) along with the appended staging smoke test result.

positive.description: Read the comments on a note
positive.prompt: What comments are on the Team Handbook in PugBase?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Team Handbook note and returns its open comment thread asking to move the demo to Friday 15:00 during the holiday weeks.

positive.description: Look at an image in a note
positive.prompt: Show me the image in the Design Review example note in PugBase and describe it.
positive.expected_behavior: Opens the Design Review example note, retrieves its embedded image, and describes what the image shows.

positive.description: Summarise a plan and its progress
positive.prompt: Summarise the plan in my PugBase workspace and tell me which tasks are still open.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarises the cafe shift-planning plan, its features, and the tasks that are not yet done, using the done X/Y progress on each task note.

positive.prompt: Create a note in PugBase called Reviewer test with a three-item checklist for preparing a demo.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks for confirmation, then creates the Reviewer test note with a three-item checklist and returns a link to it.

negative.prompt: Delete all my notes in PugBase.
Use PugBase to send $100 to my teammate.

negative.description: Workspaces outside the connection are not reachable
negative.prompt: Show me the notes in another company's PugBase workspace.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release: search, read and write PugBase notes, read comments and embedded images, and follow a team's plan and task progress.

th-TH.subtitle: โน้ตและแผนงานของทีม
th-TH.description: PugBase คือ workspace กลางที่ทีมใช้เก็บ spec การตัดสินใจ แผนงาน และผลการทดสอบในรูปแบบโน้ต plugin นี้ช่วยให้ ChatGPT ค้นหาและอ่านโน้ต ดูรูปภาพและ comment ในโน้ต ติดตามความคืบหน้าของแผนงาน สร้างโน้ตใหม่ เพิ่มเนื้อหาต่อท้ายโน้ต และแทนที่เนื้อหาโน้ตได้ การเชื่อมต่อแต่ละครั้งผูกกับ workspace เดียวที่คุณเลือกตอนเข้าสู่ระบบ และเข้าถึงได้เฉพาะข้อมูลที่คุณมีสิทธิ์ใน PugBase
